up: Retrieve compounds from document CHEMBL5726928 that have a canonical SMILES. Return their ChEMBL IDs and preferred names. Only include compounds where a canonical SMILES is available. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726928' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
